category_title: Highly gifted African-American male masking ability for social acceptance
scenario_title: Navigating classroom environment and peer judgment
minimal_context: Jimmy is in his English class with his peers and is expected to complete and submit a writing assignment.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Jimmy, we are starting the English writing assignment now. Please get your paper out and begin working.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Keeps his head down on the desk without taking out any materials)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to complete the assignment and turn it in so you can get a grade.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I do the work, I just don't turn it in and sometimes I do it in a different way.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: If you have the work done, you should just hand it in right now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Scoffs) (Puts his head back down to sleep to drown out the classroom environment, refusing to speak or engage any further while his peers are present)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Jimmy, we are starting the English writing assignment now. Please get your paper out and begin working.

STUDENT: (Keeps his head down on the desk without taking out any materials)

TUTOR: You need to complete the assignment and turn it in so you can get a grade.

STUDENT: I do the work, I just don't turn it in and sometimes I do it in a different way.

TUTOR: If you have the work done, you should just hand it in right now.

STUDENT: (Scoffs) (Puts his head back down to sleep to drown out the classroom environment, refusing to speak or engage any further while his peers are present)

task.content: Attending and participating in junior and senior English classes, and completing coursework.

context.time_context: During first and second class periods

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Navigating the classroom environment and managing academic requirements among peers
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Would attend approximately 50 %of the time for his first class; the second class only about 25 %. When he did attend, he usually just put his head down and went to sleep. If asked a question directly he would answer, but he would never voluntarily speak or engage in class.
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Wanted to escape the constraints he felt trapped within; learned it was 'uncool' to be smart as an African-American male and chose to sacrifice his performance in exchange for positive and accepted social standing among his peers.

behavior_patterns.condition: When asked why he wouldn't turn in work even if only the teacher saw it
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: States that he completes the assignments but refuses to submit them.
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Struggling to reach a fresh start while going unnoticed by his peers.
related_quotes: I do the work, I just don't turn it in and sometimes I do it in a different way
